keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Daouda Weidmann (Twente).
Delay in match because of an injury Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Freiburg 1, Twente 0. Cyriaque Irié (Freiburg) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Yuito Suzuki with a through ball following a fast break.
Christian Günter (Freiburg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Freiburg 1, Twente 1. Younes Taha (Twente) from a free kick with a left footed shot to the top right corner.
Substitution, Twente. Marko Pjaca replaces Younes Taha.
Substitution, Twente. Kristian Hlynsson replaces Daan Rots.
Substitution, Freiburg. Jordy Makengo replaces Christian Günter.
Substitution, Freiburg. Lucas Höler replaces Yuito Suzuki.
Substitution, Freiburg. Niklas Beste replaces Cyriaque Irié.
Substitution, Twente. Jordy Bawuah replaces Daouda Weidmann.
Bart van Rooij (Twente) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Freiburg. Derry Scherhant replaces Vincenzo Grifo.
Substitution, Freiburg. Philipp Lienhart replaces Max Rosenfelder.
Substitution, Twente. Lucas Vennegoor of Hesselink replaces Aske Adelgaard.
Substitution, Twente. Stav Lemkin replaces Sondre Ørjasæter.
